reset.src: FiiO Control resetDefault is configured (command 0x21) but show:false (scope-fiio.md:71,81-82); the vendor software hides it, Contour offers it anyway by owner decision 21.10.2026 (FiioReset.OFFERED); proven on the phone 22.10.2026 (run:2026-10-22-fiio-ka15-05-phone, FiioReset.VERIFIED)

hwVolume.src: vendor HID volume 0x02 is shown by FiiO Control (VB) and read on hardware; write proven on the phone 21.10.2026 (run:2026-10-21-fiio-ka15-02-phone; scope-fiio.md:56,73,85); UAC Feature Unit not used by vendor software

evidenceCaveats: Explicit FiiO route for exact FIIO KA15 2972:0104; ignore upstream WalkPlay-SchemeNo10 collision

rangesAccepted.note: Ten bands, USER1-3, all seven filter types and the preamp written and read back on the PC and on phones. A fractional preamp (-4.5, -3.5, -2.5 dB) resets the DAC during the send while every whole dB passes, so the plan rounds the preamp down to a whole dB.

acoustic.note: PK and both shelves within 0.010 dB at a 44.1 kHz stream (shelf Q = register / sqrt2); LP, HP, BP and AP passed in a later run; the preamp played -6.001 and -3.001 dB for -6 and -3. USER presets play 12 dB below Close EQ (register offset 12 dB).

persistence.note: USER2 content and its name survived unplug and replug (Pixel).

settings.note: Volume, volume steps, balance, filter, output, DRE, brightness, screen off, rotation and language written, read back and restored on a phone; the USB audio row is never written.

tested.beyondVendor: FiiO Control and the FiiO web app list all seven filter types for the KA15; Contour offers them since 2026-10-25 (written and read back on the PC and a phone). FiiO Control hides the factory reset (command 0x21); Contour offers FACTORY RESET with a saved copy first (proven on a phone 2026-10-22: replug, six changes, restore OK).
